findings.title: [P0] Restore the `RequestOptions` export removed from types.ts
findings.body: The PR deletes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }` from `src/types.ts`, but `src/client.ts:1` still imports it: `import { RequestOptions, ClientOptions } from "./types";` and `request(path: string, options: RequestOptions)` continues to reference it (`options.timeoutMs`). A named import can only resolve to an actual export of the target module, so any TypeScript build including `src/client.ts` fails with `TS2305: Module '"./types"' has no exported member 'RequestOptions'`. The repo contains only these two files, so no other module can supply the export — this breaks compilation unconditionally, despite the PR body claiming contracts are preserved. Restore the export (or redefine/remove the `RequestOptions` usage in `client.ts` together with it).

findings.title: [nit] Drop the unused `ClientOptions` import in client.ts
findings.body: The import was widened to `{ RequestOptions, ClientOptions }`, but `ClientOptions` is never referenced anywhere in `src/client.ts`. It's dead code that will trip `noUnusedLocals`/`no-unused-vars` in stricter configurations. Remove it unless a follow-up change actually uses it.
